reason: Visible instruction-level cost: in `Llibxsmm_78`, the packing loop issues 32 `ld1w` loads, each followed by an `add x1`, then moves the loaded vectors into ZA. This is a concrete repeated load/address-update sequence, but instruction count alone does not show that it limits throughput. The first eight proposals describe the same 16-call panel32 wrapper experiment, so their relative order is only a tie-break; the helper has correctness evidence but no performance measurement. The supplied augmented baseline scored 1034.6–1071.2 GFLOP/s, below target. Rank the B-layout change lower because compatibility with the generated kernel’s internal B interpretation is unverified and it adds a full-matrix pack. Rank tail alignment last because it does not change the n=512 fast path.
